response.sql:
WITH scope_averages AS (
  SELECT
    u.acctscope,
    AVG(f.feerate - f.rebrate) AS avg_net_rate,
    COUNT(*) AS fee_count
  FROM fees f
  INNER JOIN orders o ON f.orderslink = o.recordvault
  INNER JOIN users u ON o.userlink = u.userstamp
  WHERE (f.feerate - f.rebrate) IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY u.acctscope
),
overall_average AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_net_rate) AS overall_avg
  FROM scope_averages
)
SELECT
  sa.acctscope,
  sa.avg_net_rate,
  sa.fee_count,
  sa.avg_net_rate - oa.overall_avg AS difference_from_overall
FROM scope_averages sa
CROSS JOIN overall_average oa
ORDER BY sa.acctscope;

assumptions.assumption: Fee records with NULL feerate or NULL rebrate are excluded from all calculations. The net rate (feerate − rebrate) is computed only for records where both values are present.

alternatives.interpretation: The 'plain average of the per-scope averages' could be interpreted as a weighted average, where each scope's average is weighted by its fee record count. This is equivalent to the grand average across all individual fee records, rather than an unweighted mean of scope averages.
alternatives.sql:
WITH scope_averages AS (
  SELECT
    u.acctscope,
    AVG(f.feerate - f.rebrate) AS avg_net_rate,
    COUNT(*) AS fee_count
  FROM fees f
  INNER JOIN orders o ON f.orderslink = o.recordvault
  INNER JOIN users u ON o.userlink = u.userstamp
  WHERE (f.feerate - f.rebrate) IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY u.acctscope
),
overall_average AS (
  SELECT SUM(avg_net_rate * fee_count) / SUM(fee_count) AS overall_avg
  FROM scope_averages
)
SELECT
  sa.acctscope,
  sa.avg_net_rate,
  sa.fee_count,
  sa.avg_net_rate - oa.overall_avg AS difference_from_overall
FROM scope_averages sa
CROSS JOIN overall_average oa
ORDER BY sa.acctscope;
